qualified_claims: Ribasim v2026.1.1 BMI.update_until delegates the requested interval to step!(model, dt).
With fixed allocation.dt, step! solves allocation only when the current model time lies on the allocation.dt grid before the physical step.
The fixed allocation.dt path is independent of solver.saveat.
A fixed-grid allocation solve uses update_allocation! with record=true and therefore applies UserDemand and per-link allocation state through parse_allocations!.
The later allocation-tstop architecture used by the DUMMY-19 research pin is absent from this product release.

version_relation.consequence: DUMMY-19 saveat/BMI clock results are not direct runtime authority for the Ribasim release bundled by the pinned iMOD Coupler product.

product_clock_implication: For fixed allocation.dt=24h and 6h RibaMod/MF6 product steps, v2026.1.1 does not create additional within-day UserDemand allocation decisions solely because update_until endpoints occur every 6h.
For fixed allocation.dt=6h, each 6h product-step start is an allocation boundary and the new UserDemand allocation is applied before that physical segment.
Changing solver.saveat alone does not change fixed allocation.dt management cadence in this release.
boundaries: This is pinned source-contract authority, not yet a dynamic kernel/product run.
No claim that the later DUMMY-19 implementation semantics apply to v2026.1.1.
downstream: Execute DUMMY-20C with the actual pinned iMOD Coupler RibaMod product route and real MF6/Ribasim kernels.
